content: NestJS @nestjs/schedule supports both static @Cron() decorated methods (fixed expression known at compile time) and dynamic SchedulerRegistry.addCronJob/getCronJobs/deleteCronJob for runtime-registered jobs. For two fixed-interval pollers (1-min fixtures cron, ~15s replay-arm poll) use two separate @Cron() methods -- SchedulerRegistry dynamic API is unnecessary since both intervals are known at compile time.
